title: Warehouse
description: A warehouse holding stock up to a capacity. Order stock from the supplier (charged to the company budget) or transfer stock to another warehouse (a cross-Thing effect, no cost). Bounds are honored: currentStock may never exceed its capacity or fall below 0; an action that would breach a bound applies nothing on any Thing and reports success false.

currentStock.title: Current Stock
currentStock.description: Units currently held. Bounded below by 0 and above by capacity.

capacity.title: Capacity
capacity.description: Maximum units this warehouse can hold; the upper bound on currentStock.

orderCounter.title: Order Counter
orderCounter.description: Number of successful orders placed; backs deterministic order ids.

orderStock.title: Order Stock
orderStock.description: Order units from the supplier; cost is the supplier's unit price times the quantity, charged to the company budget. Rejected (no effect anywhere) if it would push stock above capacity.
orderStock.vre:effects: const company = <company-budget>; const supplier = <supplier>; const system = <warehouse-system>; currentStock' = ((currentStock + quantity) <= capacity) ? (currentStock + quantity) : currentStock; orderCounter' = ((currentStock + quantity) <= capacity) ? (orderCounter + 1) : orderCounter; company.monthlySpent' = ((currentStock + quantity) <= capacity) ? (company.monthlySpent + quantity * supplier.unitPrice) : company.monthlySpent; company.remainingBudget' = ((currentStock + quantity) <= capacity) ? (company.remainingBudget - quantity * supplier.unitPrice) : company.remainingBudget; utilizationPercent' = ((currentStock + quantity) <= capacity) ? ((currentStock + quantity) / capacity * 100) : utilizationPercent; system.totalCurrentStock' = ((currentStock + quantity) <= capacity) ? (system.totalCurrentStock + quantity) : system.totalCurrentStock; output.success = (currentStock + quantity) <= capacity; output.cost = ((currentStock + quantity) <= capacity) ? (quantity * supplier.unitPrice) : 0; output.newStock = currentStock'; output.orderId = "ORD-" + this.id + "-" + orderCounter'; output.message = ((currentStock + quantity) <= capacity) ? ("Ordered " + quantity + " units") : "Order exceeds capacity";

transferStock.title: Transfer Stock
transferStock.description: Move units from this warehouse to another warehouse. Rejected (no effect anywhere) if it would push the destination above its capacity or take this warehouse below 0.
transferStock.vre:effects: currentStock' = (((toWarehouse.currentStock + quantity) <= toWarehouse.capacity) && ((currentStock - quantity) >= 0)) ? (currentStock - quantity) : currentStock; toWarehouse.currentStock' = (((toWarehouse.currentStock + quantity) <= toWarehouse.capacity) && ((currentStock - quantity) >= 0)) ? (toWarehouse.currentStock + quantity) : toWarehouse.currentStock; utilizationPercent' = (((toWarehouse.currentStock + quantity) <= toWarehouse.capacity) && ((currentStock - quantity) >= 0)) ? ((currentStock - quantity) / capacity * 100) : utilizationPercent; toWarehouse.utilizationPercent' = (((toWarehouse.currentStock + quantity) <= toWarehouse.capacity) && ((currentStock - quantity) >= 0)) ? ((toWarehouse.currentStock + quantity) / toWarehouse.capacity * 100) : toWarehouse.utilizationPercent; output.success = ((toWarehouse.currentStock + quantity) <= toWarehouse.capacity) && ((currentStock - quantity) >= 0); output.quantity = quantity; output.from.currentStock = currentStock'; output.to.currentStock = toWarehouse.currentStock';
